title: Clouds as a rhythm
text:
I always keep the blinds down in my room. Sometimes I just stare at an empty wall, and let my mind
wonder, and occasionally I notice when clouds pass by, casting lights and shadows onto the wall. And
when there are curtains, I would stare at the sliver of light managing to get through. Somehow this ocean-
current like rhythm calms me.
why: Connects the collected clouds to the original writing and installation rhythm.

title: The loop already exists
text:
I wish my brain can stop replaying every moment of my day over and over again. Magnifying every
thing, whatever mistake seem bigger, and nothing is accomplished. I feel miserable.
why: States the repeating-thought experience directly without names or locations.

title: Sound, voice, memory
text:
Can it be
A sound
A voice
A feeling
A memory
Bothering me
Tellling me
Coercing me
Huanting me
why: Preserves short lines, repeated address, and source spelling; connects sound and text.

title: Language switching
text:
想去去不了的地方,想做不敢做的事。
说了要干的事儿,到点因为懒而不做。
why: Shows Chinese-language material without translating or inventing replacement text.

title: Source for the RAG comparison
text:
I saw a Polaroid on the street today,
Resting by the root of a lamp post,
Outside of a romantic restaurant,
It was two happy girls,
But I can only imagine the worst.
why: Identifiable wording reappears in both submitted story generations.
